status_at_registration: EXPLORATORY — NOT A CONFIRMATORY TEST. Registered before any code change or scoring of this rule; the tape is burned
registered_by: FTN research bridge (agent-generated, on the user's D22 decision); not ORION
registered_at: 2026-10-04 (SAST); this file's git commit on branch feat/ftn-research-bridge is the registration timestamp, and it precedes the commit that implements the rule
decision_ref: ftn/docs/review/REPORT.md D22 (user decision 2026-10-04: put REV's stop beyond the raid instead of at the raided level)
parent_rules: REV direction from the raid (REPORT F24 / D18 fix, commit a795a57): high raided -> bearish, low raided -> bullish, both/neither -> no ticket

rule.raid_extreme: the most extreme price printed by the raid leg: max(high) (bearish) or min(low) (bullish) over the 15m kernel bars from the raid bar (the first 15m bar that traded through the raided level, mss_meta.raid_bar_index from ftn.os.mss.detect_mss) through the entry bar (the 15m bar whose close is the kernel ticket / entry), inclusive. Causal: only bars available at the entry close are used
rule.buffer: 1 pip in the kernel's own per-instrument unit (evidence.pip): 1.0 index point for US100 and US500 (ftn.research.daycontext sets pip = 1.0), 0.0001 for EURUSD fixtures
rule.buffer_justification: one simple rule fixed in advance: the unit already defined per instrument inside the kernel (also used by PIP20), so no new parameter and no ATR window/multiple to choose; it only has to put the stop strictly beyond the printed extreme, and 1 point is the same order as the frozen round-trip costs (US100 1.6 / US500 1.0 pt). No other buffer values will be run or reported
rule.fallback_without_bars: if no raid bar index is available (hand-labelled fixtures without bars_m15), the raided level price is the only known extreme: stop = level + buffer (bearish) / level - buffer (bullish), stop_source 'beyond_raided_level_no_bars'
rule.scope: REV only. CONSO, BB and PIP20 stops are unchanged

unchanged.targets: fixed 2R from entry using the new stop distance; stop / 2R / 16:00 NY time exit; stop-first on ambiguous 1m bars (ftn/src/ftn/research/outcomes.py)
unchanged.entry: close of the 15m kernel ticket bar; one ticket per session (London 02:00-05:00, NY AM 07:00-10:00 NY)
unchanged.tradeable: every research-draft gate passes except the empty allowlist and the I0 contract gate
unchanged.statistics: percentile bootstrap 10,000 resamples seed 20261004; one-sided permutation p; Holm across the evaluated FTN-H001..H013 family per instrument; min group n 10; random-entry foil 2,000 replicates (same day + killzone, random minute, random side, same risk_pts/target/costs/exit)

series.window: 2025-08-25 -> 2026-09-25 (same files as the two prior FTN scores)

readouts: three-column comparison per instrument: before the raid fix / after the raid fix / after stop-beyond-raid: kernel tickets, tradeable N, mean R after costs with 95% CI, foil percentile, blocked counts by reason, Holm table
